name: code-particle-assemble
title: Code Particle Assemble
description: A snippet of highlighted code assembles out of thousands of particles: each lit pixel of the text flies in from a seeded scatter in 3D, white and bright in flight, and lands in its true syntax colour. WebGL points.
useWhen: A code snippet that should assemble itself out of dust: developer tools, API and tutorial intros.
A reveal that can sit behind or before a feature headline.
avoidWhen: Long snippets: the particle count grows with the number of lit pixels.
The render budget is tight: tens of thousands of points are drawn per frame in software.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Code
variables.description: The snippet shown. Use line breaks; JavaScript-like syntax is highlighted with a GitHub-dark palette.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Code text needs 0.75.
